data.title: Choose the sentence that uses the word correctly.

sections.title: apartment
sections.question: apartment
sections.summary: a set of rooms for living in, usually on one floor of a large building

senses.definition: a set of rooms for living in, usually on one floor of a large building
examples: She rents a small apartment on the third floor of the building.
They moved into a new apartment in the city centre last month.

answers.answer: She rents a small apartment on the third floor of the building.
He swims in his apartment every morning to keep fit.
She goes to the apartment to buy fresh vegetables for dinner.
They parked both cars inside the apartment to keep them safe.

sections.title: bathroom
sections.question: bathroom
sections.summary: a room containing a bath or shower, a washbasin, and often a toilet

senses.definition: a room in a house containing a bath or shower, a basin, and often a toilet
examples: She went to the bathroom to have a shower before breakfast.
The apartment has two bathrooms, one on each floor.

answers.answer: He went to the bathroom to brush his teeth before going to bed.
She made a cup of tea in the bathroom every morning before work.
They eat dinner together in the bathroom every evening.
He watches his favourite TV programme in the bathroom after dinner.

sections.title: bedroom
sections.question: bedroom
sections.summary: a room used mainly for sleeping

senses.definition: a room in a house or flat used mainly for sleeping
examples: She has a comfortable bedroom with a large window and a double bed.
The children share a bedroom at the top of the house.

answers.answer: She has a comfortable bedroom with a big window and a double bed.
He cooks breakfast in the bedroom every morning before school.
They park the car in the bedroom at the end of each day.
She washes the dirty dishes in the bedroom after every meal.

sections.title: dining room
sections.question: dining room
sections.summary: a room in a house used for eating meals

senses.definition: a room in a house or hotel where meals are eaten
examples: The family always eats Sunday lunch together in the dining room.
The dining room has a big table with six chairs around it.

answers.answer: The whole family sits together in the dining room for dinner every evening.
She has a bath in the dining room every Sunday morning.
He keeps his car in the dining room to protect it from the rain.
They sleep in the dining room because it is the warmest room in the house.

sections.title: door
sections.question: door
sections.summary: a flat object that opens and closes to allow entry into a building, room, or vehicle

senses.definition: a flat object, usually made of wood or glass, that you open and close to enter or leave a room, building, or vehicle
examples: She knocked on the door and waited for someone to answer.
He opened the door to let his friend into the house.

answers.answer: She opened the door and walked into the warm house.
He sat on the door and watched television all evening.
She cooked the chicken in the door for two hours until it was ready.
He slept on top of the door because it was the most comfortable place.

sections.title: garage
sections.question: garage
sections.summary: a building where a car is kept; also a place where cars are repaired

senses.definition: a building where a car is kept, usually next to or part of a house
examples: He put the car in the garage before the storm started.
Their house has a garage big enough for two cars.

senses.definition: a place where cars are repaired or where petrol is sold
examples: She took her car to the garage because the engine was making a strange noise.

answers.answer: He drove the car into the garage and closed the door behind him.
She cooked a big dinner in the garage for the whole family.
He brushes his teeth in the garage every morning and evening.
They sleep in the garage because it has the most space in the house.

sections.title: garden
sections.question: garden
sections.summary: a piece of land next to a house where flowers, grass, and plants grow

senses.definition: a piece of land next to a house where flowers, grass, trees, and vegetables can grow
examples: She spent the afternoon planting flowers in the garden.
The children played in the garden all day in the sunshine.

answers.answer: She grows tomatoes and sunflowers in her garden every summer.
He had a long hot shower in the garden after his morning run.
She washed all the dirty dishes in the garden after the dinner party.
He watches the news in the garden on his big sofa every evening.

sections.title: house
sections.question: house
sections.summary: a building where people, usually one family, live

senses.definition: a building where people, usually one family, live
examples: They bought a new house with three bedrooms and a large garden.
She grew up in a small house in the countryside.

answers.answer: They bought a new house with three bedrooms and a large garden.
She went to the house to buy bread and milk for breakfast.
He swam twenty laps in the house every morning to keep fit.
She parked her car inside the house before going upstairs.

sections.title: kitchen
sections.question: kitchen
sections.summary: a room where food is prepared and cooked

senses.definition: a room where food is prepared and cooked
examples: She made a fresh pot of soup in the kitchen for lunch.
He spent an hour in the kitchen preparing dinner for the guests.

answers.answer: She cooked a delicious pasta dish in the kitchen for the whole family.
He had a long hot bath in the kitchen after a tiring day at work.
She sleeps in the kitchen because it is the warmest room in winter.
They park both their cars in the kitchen every night.

sections.title: living room
sections.question: living room
sections.summary: the main room in a house where people relax, watch television, and spend time together

senses.definition: the main room in a house where people sit, relax, and watch television
examples: The family sat together in the living room to watch a film after dinner.
She reads books in the living room every evening before bed.

answers.answer: The family sat in the living room to watch a film after dinner.
She cooked a big meal in the living room for all her guests.
He parked his motorbike in the living room to keep it safe from the rain.
They had a bath in the living room before going to bed each night.
